name: M3_PPS200MI_LstLineTrans
description: List detailed goods receipt records for a purchase order line. Each record represents one goods receipt reporting event and includes purchase order identifiers (company, facility, order number, line, subline, line suffix, receiving number), warehouse and location, lot and container, reported quantities, transaction date and time, shipment and arrival dates, and logistics references such as delivery note, bill of lading, carrier, forwarding agent, and number of packages. The purchase reporting transaction type input must be validated and must be set to value 4; other values are not accepted.

inputParameters.name: PRTR
inputParameters.description: Purchase reporting transaction type, which must be set to 4 to list goods receipt transactions for a purchase order line.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number used to limit which company’s goods receipt transactions are listed; defaults to the logged-in company.

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number used to restrict the list to receipts for a specific purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PNLI
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line number used to restrict the list to receipts for a specific order line.

inputParameters.name: PNLS
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line suffix used to restrict the list to receipts for a specific split of the line.

inputParameters.name: REPN
inputParameters.description: Receiving number used to select or restrict the list to a specific goods receipt transaction.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for the goods receipt transaction.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the goods receipt was processed.

outputParameters.name: PUNO
outputParameters.description: Purchase order number related to the goods receipt transaction.

outputParameters.name: PNLI
outputParameters.description: Purchase order line number related to the goods receipt transaction.

outputParameters.name: PNLS
outputParameters.description: Purchase order line suffix related to the goods receipt transaction.

outputParameters.name: PNLX
outputParameters.description: Additional line suffix identifying the specific goods receipt transaction line.

outputParameters.name: REPN
outputParameters.description: Receiving number uniquely identifying the goods receipt transaction.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the goods were received.

outputParameters.name: WHSL
outputParameters.description: Warehouse location where the goods were received.

outputParameters.name: BANO
outputParameters.description: Lot number of the received goods.

outputParameters.name: CAMU
outputParameters.description: Container on which the goods were received.

outputParameters.name: SUDO
outputParameters.description: Supplier's delivery note number reported for this receipt.

outputParameters.name: PUOS
outputParameters.description: Status of the purchase order transaction corresponding to this goods receipt.

outputParameters.name: NEAC
outputParameters.description: Next planned activity in the goods receiving flow for this transaction.

outputParameters.name: UGCD
outputParameters.description: Urgency code indicating potential shortages and the priority of this receipt.

outputParameters.name: REOR
outputParameters.description: Sequence number indicating the reporting order of call-off lines within the receiving flow.

outputParameters.name: CHPO
outputParameters.description: Check points code indicating control points passed or required for this goods receipt transaction.

outputParameters.name: RPQA
outputParameters.description: Reported quantity received on this transaction in an alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: RPQT
outputParameters.description: Reported quantity for this goods receipt transaction in the transaction unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: TRDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the goods receipt transaction was reported.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this receipt affects material planning.

outputParameters.name: RENE
outputParameters.description: User or role responsible for the next process step after this goods receipt.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User responsible for this goods receipt transaction.

outputParameters.name: BOLN
outputParameters.description: Bill of lading number associated with the shipment.

outputParameters.name: CARN
outputParameters.description: Name of the carrier that transported the goods.

outputParameters.name: SMDT
outputParameters.description: Shipment date of the delivery as entered in shipment reporting, used for put-away planning.

outputParameters.name: ARDT
outputParameters.description: Arrival date when the goods reached the receiving unit.

outputParameters.name: NOPK
outputParameters.description: Number of packages included in this delivery for the location.

outputParameters.name: FWRF
outputParameters.description: Reference identifying the forwarding agent responsible for the shipment.

outputParameters.name: OEND
outputParameters.description: Indicator showing whether the purchase order line is flagged as fully completed with no remaining quantity to receive.

outputParameters.name: SCOP
outputParameters.description: Obsolete indicator formerly used to control whether item cost price should be sent to the point-of-sale system.

outputParameters.name: SERA
outputParameters.description: Exchange rate saved for converting the received cost to local currency for this transaction.

outputParameters.name: DTID
outputParameters.description: Internal data identity linking this transaction line to related detailed messages or records.

outputParameters.name: TIHM
outputParameters.description: Time of day when the goods receipt transaction was reported.

outputParameters.name: DLIX
outputParameters.description: Delivery number for the shipment that includes this goods receipt.

outputParameters.name: AGNB
outputParameters.description: Agreement number under which this purchase transaction is placed, if applicable.

outputParameters.name: RGDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this goods receipt transaction record was created.

outputParameters.name: RGTM
outputParameters.description: Time when this goods receipt transaction record was created.
